### Glofox member sync (daily 5:30am New York)
Reads every member of each branch in **Config**, counts the ones whose membership status is in `countStatuses`, and sets **Active Members** on each Capacity row from the Glofox membership names listed in its **Glofox Memberships** column (one per line). Stamps **Active Counted At**, which the waitlist engine treats as a recount. Stops without changing anything if Glofox returns an error or an incomplete list; a count that falls by more than half is held back and flagged. One **Active Synced** row in the Activity Log says what changed and which Glofox memberships are not counted anywhere.
